newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Centertel ups 1996 net to PLN 253.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish Centertel ups 1996 net to PLN 253.4 mln.

text.p: Polish cellular telephone firm PTK Centertel, in which France Telecom has a 34 percent stake, lifted its net profit to 253.4 million zlotys in 1996, from 147 million in 1995, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Centertel, in which Polish state-owned telecoms monopolist TPSA has a 66 percent stake, said its revenues rose to 584.9 million zlotys from 421.5 million in 1995.

Centertel was the first cellular telephone firm in Poland and started operating in 1991. Since late last year it has been facing competition from two digital operators on the cellular phone market -- Era GSM and Plus GSM.
